cohort: Women admitted to the OBGYN ES of the Clinica Mangiagalli, Milan, Italy, from February 23rd to June 24th 2019 (pre-lockdown) and February 23rd to June 23rd, 2020 (lockdown)
finding: The COVID-19 lockdown negatively impacted ES admissions, particularly for gynecological complaints, and was associated with an increase in intrauterine deaths and a decrease in natural births.
mod_finding: The frequency of admission for elective caesarean section/labor induction increased significantly during the lockdown compared to the same period in 2019.
